title: Zelda's Hair Clinic - Research Results
description: Structured current-market SEO, search-intent, competitor, Ubersuggest keyword, content-strategy, and content-opportunity research for Zelda's Hair Clinic. The research package is designed to support accurate, useful, search-focused Draft 1 content covering appropriate hair loss, scalp health, trichology, hair restoration, hair replacement, natural hair care, salon, functional nutrition, and wellness topics when relevant to the clinic's known services. Health-related research must remain evidence-aware, avoid unsupported medical claims, and clearly distinguish educational information from diagnosis or treatment.

request_id.description: Unique Request ID generated using the current date and 24-hour time in the format ZHC-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.

content_type.description: Selected content format. For the normal scheduled article workflow, use SEO Blog.

topic_area.description: Primary subject area for the selected Zelda's Hair Clinic content opportunity.

target_audience.description: Specific audience most likely to benefit from the selected topic.

business_goal.description: Primary business objective supported by the content, such as organic search visibility, education, lead generation, consultation interest, service awareness, or brand authority.

search_location.description: Geographic search market used for the research. Use United States unless a more specific location is appropriate to the content opportunity.

research_priority.description: Priority assigned to the content opportunity.

ubersuggest_available.description: True only when the connected Ubersuggest MCP tool successfully returned keyword data during this run.

search_volume.description: Actual monthly search volume returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Never estimate or infer this value. Return an empty string when unavailable.

seo_difficulty.description: Actual SEO Difficulty returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Never estimate or infer this value. Return an empty string when unavailable.

paid_difficulty.description: Actual Paid Difficulty returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Never estimate or infer this value. Return an empty string when unavailable.

cost_per_click.description: Actual cost-per-click value returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Never estimate or infer this value. Return an empty string when unavailable.

keyword_intent.description: Search intent classification returned directly by Ubersuggest when available. Return an empty string when unavailable.

keyword_trend.description: Actual keyword trend or seasonality information returned by Ubersuggest. Never estimate or infer this value. Return an empty string when unavailable.

ubersuggest_related_keywords.description: Related keyword opportunities returned by Ubersuggest, separated by semicolons. Return an empty string when unavailable.

ubersuggest_competitor_gaps.description: Competitor keyword gaps or opportunities identified through Ubersuggest. Return an empty string when unavailable.

related_service.description: Most relevant known Zelda's Hair Clinic service connected to the topic. Use only services supported by supplied business information or reliable research context. Do not invent a service name. Return an empty string when none clearly applies.

related_book.description: Reserved reusable Urban Chirp Content Engine field. For Zelda's Hair Clinic, return an empty string.

cta.description: Recommended call to action aligned with the selected topic and business goal. The CTA may encourage learning more about a relevant Zelda's Hair Clinic service or scheduling an appropriate consultation, but must not guarantee hair growth, restoration, diagnosis, treatment success, or health outcomes.

special_instructions.description: Topic-specific writing cautions, health-content safeguards, compliance considerations, required distinctions, emphasis, or editorial instructions for the later article-writing stage.

primary_keyword.description: Primary SEO keyword selected or confirmed for the content opportunity using current research and, when available, Ubersuggest data.

secondary_keywords.description: Relevant secondary keywords, long-tail terms, and semantic variations separated by semicolons.

search_intent.description: Dominant search intent for the selected topic based on current search research.

search_demand_summary.description: Concise explanation of what searchers want to learn, compare, solve, find, understand, or accomplish regarding the selected hair, scalp, trichology, hair-loss, restoration, salon, nutrition, or wellness topic.

people_also_ask.description: Relevant current search questions separated by semicolons. Do not invent questions and present them as observed search data when they were not actually identified.

related_searches.description: Relevant related searches and long-tail opportunities separated by semicolons.

competitor_urls.description: Specific competing-content URLs actually identified during current research, separated by semicolons. Never fabricate URLs.

competitor_strengths.description: Evidence-based summary of what current competing content does well, including useful coverage, organization, authority, search alignment, practical value, or other meaningful strengths.

competitor_gaps.description: Evidence-based summary of meaningful gaps, weaknesses, unanswered questions, outdated information, insufficient depth, unclear explanations, or other opportunities found in competing content.

unique_content_angle.description: Recommended differentiated content angle for Zelda's Hair Clinic based on audience needs, competitor gaps, search intent, current search demand, business goals, and the clinic's supported areas of expertise.

recommended_title.description: SEO-focused working title aligned with the primary keyword, current research, search intent, Zelda's Hair Clinic positioning, and factual-health-content safeguards. Avoid clickbait, diagnosis language, or unsupported promises.

recommended_outline.description: Substantive H2 and H3 article outline capable of supporting a useful Draft 1 article of at least 600 words. The outline should answer search intent thoroughly without padding, repetition, unsupported medical claims, or invented information.

opportunity_score.description: Content-opportunity score based on Zelda's Hair Clinic relevance, audience usefulness, search intent, business fit, competitive gap, SEO opportunity, conversion potential, differentiation, and ability to support accurate educational content.

ai_recommendation.description: Strategic recommendation for the later article-writing step, including the most useful direction, content emphasis, important search questions, differentiation opportunities, and any factual or health-related cautions.

research_sources.description: Specific authoritative URLs actually accessed during current research, separated by semicolons. Favor government health agencies, recognized medical or professional organizations, universities, peer-reviewed resources, and other credible primary or authoritative sources when health-related claims are involved. Never invent URLs.
